context.transcript:
Good morning, staff.
As you know, this month we moved our customer appreciation day from Monday to last Saturday on the notion that the whole family would be able to visit.
I saw some of you at demonstration tables showing our super green leaf customers how to take care of the plants they purchase and how to repot them. as they grow.
Well, I just got our sales numbers and guess what?
We had record sales for the event.
I'd like to congratulate you all on a job well done and I'll go even further.
Each one of you will receive a bonus this month.
Enjoy.
context.transcript_translation:
早上好，工作人员。
如你们所知，本月我们将客户感谢日从周一改到了上周六，是考虑到全家人都能前来参观。
我看到一些人正在展示桌前，教我们的超级绿叶顾客如何照顾他们购买的植物以及随着它们生长的如何重新盆栽。
嗯，我刚拿到我们的销售数字，猜猜怎么着？
我们为这次活动创下了记录销售额。
我想祝贺大家工作出色，而且我会更进一步。
你们每个人这个月都会收到奖金。
享受吧。
